name: Trashwing Crowchild
source:
What's a crowchild to do?

Trashwing Crowchild fell from the nest half-finished, which is rather unfortunate. Especially since being stuck outside of the nest when Halloween ends means falling apart, literally . . .

[From [url=https://featherboy.itch.io/trashwing-crowchild]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一个乌鸦孩子要做什么？

垃圾翼鸦童半成品就从巢中掉了下来，这是相当不幸的。尤其是万圣节结束时被困在巢外就意味着分崩离析。。。

[来自[url=https://featherboy.itch.io/trashwing-crowchild]itch.io[/url]]
